newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai will not threaten HK role - London Mayor.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai will not threaten HK role - London Mayor.

text.p: Shanghai officials are at pains to emphasise that the city will not threaten the position of Hong Kong after Britain hands it back to China next year, the Lord Mayor of London Sir John Chalstrey said on Thursday.

Chalstrey, who arrived in Shanghai on Tuesday for a three-day visit, met Shanghai's mayor Xu Kuangdi on Wednesday and signed a protocol between the two cities calling for greater cooperation, particularly on training of staff.

"The vice-mayor Zhao Qichen went out of his way to emphasise that Shanghai will not be stepping on Hong Kong's toes," Chalstrey said. "He said Hong Kong will be the international financial centre and Shanghai the domestic financial centre."

He said he believed there was much that London could do to help Shanghai in its effort to regain its position as a major financial centre and said there would be growing exchanges between the two cities in the future.
